name: Letrozole
mechanism: Reversible, competitive inhibitor of aromatase, suppressing peripheral conversion of androgens to oestrogens; effective in postmenopausal women or premenopausal women receiving ovarian function suppression.
monitoring: Bone mineral density at baseline and periodically, with calcium/vitamin D and bone-modifying agents as indicated
interactions: Should not be combined with tamoxifen or oestrogen-containing therapies.
resistance: Acquired ESR1 ligand-binding domain mutations, PI3K pathway activation and growth factor signalling.
